name: @NSXBet/tasks-extension
description: Tasks as an agent extension: full tk surface as LLM tools, a workspace watcher that notifies the session when issues change, and a skill injection. Loads under both pi and omp.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target bun --outdir ./dist --external @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --external @earendil-works/pi-tui --external @sinclair/typebox && bun build ./src/watch/child-entry.ts --target bun --outfile ./dist/tk-watch.js && bun run scripts/check-dist.ts
